title: Pan-Seared Skillet Steak with Corned Beef Hash
description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring a pan-seared steak accompanied by a crispy corned beef hash.
instructions: 1. Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add 2 tbsp of oil and sear the steak for 3-4 minutes per side.
3. Transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest.
4. In the same skillet, add diced onion and cook until golden brown.
5. Add diced corned beef and cook until crispy.
6. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve the steak with corned beef hash alongside.
